title: Trail Mix Has More Calories Than A Big Mac
hook: Trail mix has a great reputation because it's nuts and fruit. But one cup of trail mix has more calories than a Big Mac.
body: A serving on the label is three tablespoons, and that's one small handful. And let's keep it real, you're not eating one small handful and putting the bag away, you're watching TV or working at your desk and you keep reaching into the bag.
